identity.title: Build Runs and Run Detail console views

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Implement Runs list and Run Detail using only read APIs. Run Detail must show headline outcome plus orthogonal validation/scope, why-stopped, governance signals, validation, changes, runtime/fallbacks, and evidence refs. No client-side re-derivation. Dependency: 8023.scaffold-console.
human_pressure.why_now: Single-run explainability is the primary product surface and should precede aggregate dashboard polish.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No raw log rendering by default.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add Runs browsing and evidence-drillable Run Detail to the static console.
red_lines: No raw log rendering by default.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8023.scaffold-console. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Server-side deterministic projection/report remains authoritative read model.
contracts: Sections align with execution report API.
failure_semantics: Unavailable report is visibly unavailable, not green.

steps.title: Render Run Detail
details: Fetch run report and signals endpoints.

steps.title: Render evidence refs
details: Display logical evidence IDs/artifact refs safely.
No arbitrary local file URL execution.

steps.title: Add behavior/static tests
details: Assert API endpoint strings/section labels and absence of inference constants where practical.

acceptance: User can navigate from Runs list to one Run Detail.
Console does not calculate outcome/signal from raw events.

reject_if: Client parses raw events to decide success/failure.
Missing fields are rendered as success.
Unsafe local path links are constructed.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused static/behavior contract tests for Runs and Run Detail.
